proof:
The FY2024 OMNIBUS BUDGET as voted, inside Article 7 of the 6 May 2023 annual town meeting warrant. 94 numbered lines in 16 groups across FIVE pages, 164 to 168. The sixteen group totals sum to the printed Total Omnibus of 42,584,048.95, which is also the figure the VOTE itself states in the article text on p164 -- two independent statements of the same number on different pages. Both roll-ups close: Total Protection = police + fire + radio watch + other protection, and Total Assistance = C.O.A. + veterans.
FIFTEEN OF THE SIXTEEN GROUP TOTALS EQUAL THE SUM OF THEIR OWN LINES. `Total General Government` prints 1,974,322.04 and its twenty-two lines sum to 1,974,322.84 -- eighty cents. All twenty-two were re-read at a crop and print what is recorded here; the Total Omnibus ties using the printed 1,974,322.04, so the town’s own chain carries the same figure throughout. WHICH LINE IS SHORT IS NOT ESTABLISHED.
PAGE 168 WAS NOT LISTED IN THE TRACKER. It carries line 81, Total Schools, Total Library and the Total Omnibus, so a run read as 164-167 would have stopped four lines and three totals short of the answer.
